check.description: Activate the check comparison against reference files

generate.description: Activate the generation of reference files

items.description: Name of a summary generation rule

rules_excluded.description: List of comparisons to be excluded from rules_active

create_summary.description: List of tasks which create and initialize the summary files

analyze_summary.description: List of tasks in which the summary files are analyzed, raising an exception on check failure

suppress_exception.description: Do not raise an exception when the summary analysis finds errors, log a warning instead

label_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the task name in the summary

methods.description: Comparison methods, grouped by method name

tool.description: Name of the tool used for comparison

binary.description: Path to the binary of the tool

args_template.description: Templated arguments to provide to the tool

file_format.description: Format of the file that is expected

tolerance.description: Tolerance value used for comparison, converted to an integer by the tools. Required by the norms_checker and xtool tools

which.description: Which value to use for comparison

ignore_case.description: For the namelist_checker tool: ignore case differences

ignore_blank_lines.description: For the namelist_checker tool: ignore blank lines

ignore_whitespace.description: For the namelist_checker tool: ignore whitespace differences

summary.description: Summary generation settings, grouped by summary name

task.description: Comparison settings, grouped by task name

additionalProperties.description: Comparison rules of the task, grouped by rule name
Comparison rule settings. The parameters method, inpath, pattern and result_folder are always needed, generate_folder is needed when generate is active and reference_folder when check is active

inpath.description: Name of the input folder where input file are located

pattern.description: Regex Pattern to select the input files to compare

generate_folder.description: Folder into which the generated files will be stored

result_folder.description: Folder into which the results of the comparison will be stored
